chain: Owner: a host-only compose override dropped the board's 127.0.0.1:3129 port. The gate calls the board there for sign-in, in-app requests and feedback; every call failed, only logged, and apply still reported the generation healthy. Make the health check fail when the gate is configured and nothing answers on 127.0.0.1:3129, and make verify-security count an unpublished 3129 as a failure when the gate is configured. Platform Engineer: fix it in the product repo and ship it. Done when merged into main with checks green.
claim:
PR title: fix(ops): a generation fails health when the gate can't reach the board's sign-in listener

Why: a host-only compose.override.yaml replaced the board's `ports:` (`!override`) and omitted `127.0.0.1:3129:3129`. The gate runs on the host network and calls the board there for sign-in, in-app requests and app feedback notify. Every call failed with `TypeError: fetch failed`, only logged, while apply reported the generation healthy. An owner's in-app feedback silently never woke its agent.

What:
- `scripts/healthcheck.sh`: when `config/gate.json` exists (gate enabled), check that something answers on `127.0.0.1:3129` (any HTTP status counts; connection refused fails), with a message naming 3129 and compose.override.yaml. Apply's health phase runs this script.
- `scripts/verify-security.sh`: an unpublished 3129 is a failure, not a pass, when the gate is configured.
- `scripts/lean/baseline.json`: trusted counter +5 for the new lines.

Note: apply's health phase fails only checks that passed in its pre-apply baseline, so a host already broken before the apply is reported by healthcheck.sh but not reverted; a change that breaks it during an apply reverts the generation.

Tests: no test of the real healthcheck.sh exists (apply-atomic stubs it). `cd scripts && npm test` on a Mac: the failing set is the same as on main (apply-atomic and other environment-dependent tests); lean counters pass.
